annotations.text:
Welcome flow — framed as what it is: an OPEN SOURCE AGENT HARNESS for personal finance.

00 is the only screen that asks nothing, so it carries the positioning: a harness, not a chatbot — typed tools, audited writes, permissioned actions, and the model is yours. The figures are real (292 tools, 21 connectors), not decoration.

It also carries the fork a returning self-hoster needs — RESTORE A BACKUP — which was previously buried three screens deep.

Strictly the app's own system: Plus Jakarta Sans at 400/500/600/700 and system ui-monospace. No serif, no gradients, no glows, no cards. The only addition is the brand gold #9a7d44 from favicon.svg (#b08f4e where the base is too dim on dark).

Buttons now sit near the app's own density — 10px/26px at 13px, radius 6 — against .ui-btn's 6px/10px at 12px, radius 8. The earlier 14–15px tall pills were nearly double the product's height and read as marketing, not product.
